release_channel.description: Controls which workflow tier the agent uses (stable conservative workflows vs. experimental multi-agent / preview patterns).

read_only_mode.description: Hard-blocks file mutation tools (write_file, edit_file) in PreToolUse so the agent can only research and audit.

prod_deploy_guard.description: Controls PreToolUse behavior when run_command invokes production deployment commands (gcloud run deploy, terraform apply, kubectl apply).

prefer_uv_pytest.description: Automatically rewrites bare 'pytest' commands to 'uv run pytest' via PreToolUse argument overwrite.

strict_tdd.description: Injects an ephemeral PreInvocation directive requiring a failing test before implementation changes.
